title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 8: Solomon's building of cities, his forced labor, the daily offerings and the gold from Ophir.

questions.text: At the end of how many years had Solomon built Yahweh's house and his own house?
questions.explanation: The chapter begins at the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh's house and his own house.

questions.text: Solomon built the cities that had been given to him by whom?
questions.explanation: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to him and caused the children of Israel to live there.

questions.text: Which city did Solomon go to and prevail against?
questions.explanation: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah and prevailed against it.

questions.text: Which city did Solomon build in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Solomon built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities in Hamath.

questions.text: From whom did Solomon conscript forced labor?
questions.explanation: Solomon conscripted forced labor from the children of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites who were left in the land.

answers.text: From the peoples left in the land, not of Israel
From the children of Israel in every tribe
From the priests and the Levites of Jerusalem
From the servants whom Huram had sent him

questions.text: How many chief officers of King Solomon ruled over the people?
questions.explanation: The chief officers of King Solomon were two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

questions.text: Why would Solomon not let Pharaoh's daughter live in the house of David?
questions.explanation: He said the places where Yahweh's ark had come are holy.

answers.text: She asked for a house of her own
The places where Yahweh's ark had come are holy
The house of David had burned down
The priests would not allow a foreigner there

questions.text: At which three feasts each year did Solomon offer burnt offerings?
questions.explanation: He offered on the three set feasts: the feast of unleavened bread, the feast of weeks and the feast of booths.

questions.text: According to whose ordinance did Solomon appoint the divisions of the priests and Levites?
questions.explanation: He appointed them according to the ordinance of David his father, for David the man of God had so commanded.

questions.text: How much gold did Huram's and Solomon's servants bring from Ophir?
questions.explanation: They went to Ophir and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold to King Solomon.
